description: Read-only BuenaIA prototype that searches, details, and compares a catalog reconstructed from publicly available commercial product sheets (mobile, devices, home, business cyber, and digital protection). It helps identify coverage, overlaps, gaps, and profile fit, and links to the official pricing tool. It is not a Telefónica or Movistar sales channel, does not issue policies, and does not calculate personalized premiums.
